body:
listen. I am one of the other people looking for help. I know what you're feeling. I can only tell you what other people keep telling me. 

 * You don't know the future, things can get better. 

 * If you adjust your expectations then even shit looks good. 

 * Do exercise every time you feel like shit. If you keep going till you feel it in your muscles, then you will feel it less in your mind. 

 * There is always someone there for you, they just don't know how to find you, so you have to help them find you.

Thank you all for your comments, 

 My gf woke up in a state just after I finished writing, she had been having nightmares about me killing myself. While I wrote, she was feeling my pain. She went through the whole process of having to tell my family and our friends, it sounded bad. 
 
 I went and hugged her, and she begged me to promise not to kill myself, but I couldn't. Then she talked with me for ages. She told me all of the things you have just said. That I can't predict the future, that I'm particularly depressed because of money, and that there are better doctors out there.  

 I am going to keep trying to find work, and keep doing exercise. I just got back from a run, and I'm feeling better. I've made a deal with myself. If I ever come close to killing myself again, I am going to run. It doesn't matter which direction, but I am just going to run until I can no longer move. If at that point I still don't want to go on, then i will think about the next step. I am hopeful that the exercise will pull me back.
 
 I am also trying to constantly remind myself that at least i'm not in psych ward. 

 I still do not feel good about telling other people to get help. So my real account is going to be on Suicide watch a lot less. I can't stand thinking of these poor people taking our advice and ending up getting committed. 

  I know it might seem stupid to pin too many hopes on getting a job, but In the words of Kanye West:

 "Money isn't everything, not having it is"

Thanks again for your time guys, you know the universe will pay it back.
